Prevention: Avoid planting rice in areas where
Control insect vectors in the nursery with insecticides (see yellow control column)
Control weeds on rice fields and around fields (particularly grasses)
Reduce injuries to plants during transplanting and weeding
Set traps to prevent rodents and other animals from causing injuries
Plough under infected crop residues, volunteer rice, infected ratoons and weeds after harvest
Wash hands with soap after working on infected plants so as not to transmit to healthy plants
Monitoring: Monitor nursery weekly for yellowing of leaves, stunted growth and death of plants
Young seedlings (3-4 leaf growth stage) are most susceptible to infection, newly formed leaves are twisted and have difficulty in emerging
Monitor the fields after transplanting look for intense yellow/orange colouration of leaves, stunted growth, empty spikelets, death of plants
Vectors: look for insects with shiny black bodies or others with brown heads and dark bodies and spined thorax.
Hoppers with greenish-yellow bodies and others with greenish brown coloration
RYMV is a dangerous disease and farmers are advised to start control action soon after observing symptoms
Direct Control: Rogue and burn infected plants in the field when first seen to reduce spread of disease to healthy plants
Spray alpha-cypermethrin at 5-7.5ml/15L of water to control insect vectors in the nursery.
A contact and ingested pyrethroid insecticide, IRAC group: 3A
Spray with imidacloprid at 5-7ml/15L of water to control insect vectors in the nursery.
A systemic neonicotinoid insecticide, IRAC group: 4A
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides of
The virus can not be manged using pesticides but the insect vector can be controlled using insecticides:
Apply two times at 7-14 days interval depending on vector situation.
Alternate with other chemical group insecticide after two applications.
Apply two times at intervals of 7-14 days.
Alternate with other chemical group insecticide after two applications.
